title: Texas Roadhouse Coupons
description: Learn guitar chords for FREE through our new game Chord Master: http://bit.ly/ChordMasterYT Ask Texas Roadhouse for a deal: http://askforadeal.com  Ask For a Deal allows you to request deals and find coupons for your favorite products and services.   Connect with us: Twitter: http://twitter.com/askforadeal Facebook: http://facebook.com/askforadeal  * * *  Do you love steaks, beer and a relaxed dining atmosphere? Coupons for Texas Roadhouse can help you save money on steaks, baby back ribs, a variety of beer and many other roadhouse favorites. The restaurant typically offers a number of coupons and discounts that are posted in a variety of locations. The purpose of this video is to help you find them.   The Texas Roadhouse currently maintains over 340 locations in 46 states and plans to open new locations throughout 2011. The Texas Roadhouse also sponsors athletes and athletic competitions, including cycling. Customers can find more information on the roadhouse's involvement in athletics by visiting the restaurant's official site.   Also available on the restaurant's official site is the company's newsletter, which will give you a free appetizer coupon just for signing up! Customers can register to receive the Texas Roadhouse newsletter by clicking on the link marked, "Become a Texas Roadie VIP, Sign Up Today", which is located towards the bottom of the page. After you enter a zip code and complete the required fields, you can gain access to the promotional information and coupons contained in the company newsletter such as $5 off an order of $20 or more.   Coupons might also be found in a local Entertainment Book. Go to www.Entertainment.com and search your area to see if a coupon book is available. Many food and dining magazines, as well as newspapers or periodicals may have coupons for Texas Roadhouse available, and customers should check these often.   You can also follow Texas Roadhouse on Facebook for news, promotions, and the occasional discount or redeemable coupon. A number of coupon compiling sites also have them available, and you can often locate current ones by googling "Texas Roadhouse Coupons" and browsing the results.   For more coupons, deal saving opportunities and to request your own deals head over to http://askforadeal.com.  Connect with Texas Roadhouse Homepage: http://www.texasroadhouse.com/ Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/texasroadhouse

visual.observation: A Texas Roadhouse “VIP Roadie” signup page offers “delicious gifts and other fun stuff” delivered by email while requesting an email address, name, birthdate, favorite location, home ZIP code, and whether the user has children aged 12 or under.
visual.context: Visible branded restaurant membership/signup context; the page states that gifts and other offers are delivered by email.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised benefit is linked to signing up and submitting multiple personal details, including birthdate and household-related information; this relationship may merit review of the offer’s data-collection terms and eligibility conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether the program is legitimate, how the submitted information is used, whether gifts are delivered, or whether additional terms exist.

visual_context_notes.observation: The material is presented alongside Texas Roadhouse restaurant branding, menu pricing, gift cards, coupons, and VIP membership imagery.
The signup page visibly marks required fields with asterisks and includes a location selector showing “TX - Waco.”

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Texas Roadhouse coupons and a branded newsletter signup connected to promotional offers. The requests for personal and household details are noted, but the available video evidence describes no deceptive conduct or unsafe data use.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is ordinary restaurant discounts, coupons, and a promotional newsletter signup connected to a free appetizer offer.
